trading_execution.title: 💱 Trading & Swaps (Meme Tokens via Hyperliquid Spot)
trading_execution.description: Execute meme token swaps on Hyperliquid Spot with zero gas fees and real-time order book pricing
features: Hyperliquid Spot integration for MEME TOKENS ONLY
Supported: PURR, TRUMP, PEPE, HFUN, MOG, GMEOW, and 50+ meme tokens
All pairs use USDC as quote currency (e.g., PURR/USDC)
ZERO gas fees on Hyperliquid, only 0.02% trading fee
limitations: MAJOR TOKENS NOT SUPPORTED for swaps: ETH, BTC, SOL, LINK, UNI, AAVE, etc.
Hyperliquid is primarily a perps exchange - Spot market only has meme tokens
For major token swaps: Use external DEX aggregators (1inch, Uniswap)
